summary.text: Karla Daniels Hooper is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 113 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Don Scarbrough.
A grant writer and executive director of the Diabetes Association of Atlanta, she says in a Ballotpedia survey that she has lived in Covington for 22 years.

paragraphs.text: Daniels Hooper was born in Arkadelphia, Arkansas, and earned a high school diploma from Arkadelphia High School, a bachelor's degree from Emory University in 1996 and a graduate degree from Mercer University in 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she came to Georgia in 1992 as a college student at Emory and has served as a grant writer and executive director for the Diabetes Association of Atlanta.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Diabetes Association of Atlanta, Leading Educators and the Newton County Animal Services Board.
Daniels Hooper lost the 2024 Democratic primary for District 113 to incumbent Sharon Henderson, 65.1 percent to 34.9 percent, and advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
In her survey, she said she serves on the Newton County Comprehensive Planning Committee and the Newton County Animal Services Board and as a minister focused on empowering women and youth.
She named affordable living, senior quality of life and mental health as her policy priorities and said she would support legislation on affordable housing and lower taxes and everyday costs.
